compatibility: any AI agent that can run commands

requirements.azure_cli: for the person's own sign-in (az login)
requirements.node_and_npm: only for a RAPP Store app's Power Apps code app (leave out --no-app)

sign_in.prefer: a Developer or Sandbox environment; Production only when the person confirms

brainstem.build: python3 -m brainfreeze_studio build ../eggs/<github-login>--<short-name>.egg --name "<Agent name>" --publisher-prefix rapp --sdk-dir ../copilot-harness-sdk --translations translations/ --environment <environment> --out ../build/<short-name>

rapp_store_app.cannot_build: entries whose access is private, and complete applications with no singleton_url

sample.question: Route an invoice from Fabrikam for $18,750.
sample.check: expand the agent's Route an invoice step: its Output is exactly the answer below
sample.answer: Fabrikam $18,750.00: queue APPROVAL, needs AP manager sign-off (limit $10,000).

verify: the build's parity lines: each translated agent matches its Python on every test case, or is refused and stays a skill
the plan (--plan): what the deploy would create, update or remove, whether the agent is already published, which connection each flow uses, and the build's digest, read without changing anything
the deploy (--expect <digest>): exactly the build that was planned
the deploy's read-back: the components and their content, the flows, their links and their connections, stopping on any difference
a reply in Copilot Studio's test chat, opened from the deploy's maker: link

verification.with_the_persons_browser: an AI that can drive the person's signed-in browser asks the question in a new test chat and reports the reply it saw
verification.without_a_browser: the AI gives the person the link and the question, and says it has not seen the reply; a link alone is not a verified answer

consent.before_install: say what you will set up and where, and wait for yes
consent.before_build: say the build runs the agents' Python on this computer to prove translations (a clean environment and a temporary home and working folder, not a sandbox); build only code the person trusts
consent.before_deploy: plan the build (--plan), show what it would create, update or remove and whether the agent is already published, and wait for yes
consent.publish: only when the person asks: plan again without --draft, show it, then deploy without --draft with that plan's --expect <digest>

never: deploy to an environment the person did not pick
rebuild between the plan and the deploy
update an agent the person didn't make with brainfreeze studio: choose a new --name
remove what the person wants to keep: add --keep-extra to the plan and the deploy
use a service account, a client secret, an app-only token or someone else's connection (--use-shared-connection)
delete or change agents, flows, connections or data beyond what the plan lists, or change environment settings
print, paste or save a token
